A spear gains power with every inch of reach, using block, capture and thrust as its main attack; the broadsword is blunt and dominant, built on chops. The spear works in agile points, lines and planes, the sword in blunt chopping paths.
八面汉剑又长又窄分八面研磨，直刺横斩凌厉；空心钢管当齐眉棍用，架棍格挡刚猛。一寸短一寸险的经典博弈。

The eight-faceted Han jian is long, narrow and ground on eight faces, fierce in straight thrusts and horizontal cuts; a hollow steel pipe serves as an eyebrow-height staff, brutal in blocking. The classic contest of the peril of short range.
《杀破狼》甄子丹VS吴京巷战教科书。警棍下劈反劈斜劈连续低扫，短刀反削正推立刀格挡翻腕削腕，近身兵器格斗的极致。

The alley-fight textbook from "SPL": Donnie Yen versus Wu Jing. A baton chops down, back and diagonally with continuous low sweeps; a short blade back-slashes and pushes straight, with blade-up blocks and wrist-rolling cuts. The pinnacle of close-quarters weapon fighting.
单手立关刀，脚踢起刀快速起手，回身封刀挂刀全身扫刀，五花顺势俯身斩腿。长柄重兵器对短双刀的距离博弈。

One-handed guandao held upright, the blade flicked up with the foot for a fast start, then turning to seal and hang the blade, sweeping it around the whole body and following through into a low cut at the legs. A game of distance between a long heavy weapon and short twin blades.
三节棍单梢节握法远距离击打，中结和游离梢节点劈砸扫，跃步横扫摇棍对攻。软兵器对硬兵器的灵活博弈。

Three-section staff held by a single end for long-range strikes, the middle joint and free end used to point, smash and sweep, with hop-steps into horizontal sweeps and staff-shaking exchanges. A nimble contest of a flexible weapon against a rigid one.
《杀死比尔》经典视听设计。流星锤铁球撞击墙面，高频快切手持跟拍，机位紧贴铁球运动轨迹。软兵器远程攻击对刀剑的距离压制。

The classic audio-visual design from "Kill Bill". A meteor hammer's iron ball smashes into a wall, with high-frequency quick cuts and handheld follow shots, the camera glued to the ball's trajectory. Long-range attacks from a flexible weapon suppressing blades at distance.
2026安志杰《怒袭》冷兵器对决。横刀利用长度优势横斩斜劈撩刀控制中距离，双斧势大力沉腾空360度悬身下劈。距离控制与力量爆发的博弈。

Cold-weapon duel from the 2026 Andy On film "Raging Fury". The hengdao uses its length for horizontal cuts, diagonal chops and flicking cuts to control mid-range, while twin axes hang in the air and chop down in a 360-degree spin. A game of distance control against explosive power.
《卧底神探》释小龙长棍对打武士刀，招式利落攻防有序。长棍一寸长一寸强，武士刀近身劈砍凌厉，距离控制与贴身突破的经典博弈。

From "Undercover Detective", Shi Xiaolong's long staff against a katana, crisp techniques with orderly attack and defence. A staff gains power with reach, a katana is vicious up close: the classic game of distance control against closing the gap.
泰拳八臂拳术肘膝腿全身武器，拳击双拳快攻组合拳。站立打击流派的经典对决，拳腿组合 vs 纯拳连击。
Muay Thai's eight-limb art of elbows, knees and kicks against boxing's fast two-fist combinations. A classic matchup of standing strikers, kick-and-punch combinations versus pure hand combinations.
巴西柔术地面降服裸绞三角锁十字固，摔跤takedown压制控制。地面缠斗流派的经典对决，以小博大的杠杆技术 vs 力量压制的摔跤控制。

Brazilian jiu-jitsu ground submissions - rear naked choke, triangle choke, armbar - against wrestling takedowns and positional control. A classic matchup of grapplers: leverage that lets the smaller fighter win versus strength-based wrestling control.
综合格斗五大领域全覆盖：站立打击(拳击+泰拳)、摔跤takedown、地面降服、地面锤击、站立缠斗。真实MMA比赛的完整攻防转换。

All five domains of mixed martial arts covered: standing striking (boxing and Muay Thai), wrestling takedowns, ground submissions, ground-and-pound and standing clinch work. The full attack-defence transitions of a real MMA bout.
太极以柔克刚借力打力推手化劲，散打快拳快腿爆发力强。传统内家拳vs现代搏击的理念碰撞，以慢打快以柔克刚的经典演绎。

Tai chi yielding to overcome hardness, borrowing force and neutralizing through push-hands, against Sanda's fast punches and kicks with explosive power. A clash of ideas between a traditional internal art and a modern combat sport: slow beating fast, soft overcoming hard.
八极拳刚猛暴烈贴身靠打顶心肘铁山靠，咏春短桥窄马寸劲发力日字冲拳。刚猛外家拳vs短打内家拳的风格碰撞。

Baji quan's fierce close-range body strikes - heart-piercing elbow and iron mountain lean - against Wing Chun's short bridge, narrow stance, inch power and chain punches. A clash of styles between a fierce external art and a short-range internal one.
截拳道快攻直取以无法为有法，李小龙式简洁高效的攻防；跆拳道腿法为主华丽高踢，旋风踢后旋踢。快攻直取vs腿法华丽的风格对决。

Jeet Kune Do's fast direct attack, using no way as way, Bruce Lee's simple and efficient offence and defence, against Taekwondo's leg-focused, flashy high kicks, whirlwind and spinning kicks. A style duel of direct speed versus spectacular kicking.
《警察故事》开创的视觉群殴拍摄方式。全方位立体攻击感，主角与正前方对手对招时，反派随时从身后侧面出拳出脚，机位变化展示盲区威胁。一人同时对抗多人的真实压迫感。

The visual group-brawl shooting style pioneered by "Police Story". A sense of attack from every direction: while the lead exchanges with the opponent in front, villains throw punches and kicks from behind and the sides, and the camera moves to show the blind-spot threat. The real pressure of one man fighting many at once.
《火遮眼》18分钟警局一镜到底混战风格。零特效零替身零快剪，长镜头死死咬住主角，看着他在体力透支伤痕累累状态下用意志硬抗车轮战，窒息感拉满。

The 18-minute one-take police-station melee style of "Fire Covering the Eyes". Zero effects, zero stunt doubles, zero fast cuts: the long take clings to the lead, watching him hold on by willpower through a relay of attackers while exhausted and battered. The suffocating tension is pushed to the maximum.
《卧底神探》释小龙式一对多。小混混打架没有章法但人数占优势，主角出手极快争取每一招都一招制敌，迅速解决战斗避免缠斗。天台开阔又受限的空间里张弛有度。

The Shi Xiaolong-style one-against-many from "Undercover Detective". The thugs fight without form but hold a numbers advantage; the lead strikes extremely fast, trying to end each exchange with a single blow and finish the fight quickly to avoid grappling. The open but constrained rooftop space gives the rhythm room to breathe.
《疾速追杀》式走廊一对多枪战。狭窄空间连续击杀，战术换弹，枪斗术Gun Kata融合枪械和近身格斗。CQB室内近战战术，精准射击和近身格斗的无缝转换。

中国古代冷兵器战争层次布阵：拒马在前，刀盾兵次之，长矛兵居中，弓箭手和强弩兵在后远程压制。步兵为主弓箭为先的经典军阵冲锋场面。

Layered formation of ancient Chinese cold-weapon warfare: chevaux-de-frise in front, sword-and-shield troops next, spearmen in the middle, archers and heavy crossbows behind for ranged suppression. The classic infantry-first, archery-first formation charge.
黑甲重骑兵从战旗下冲出，战马披着厚重铁甲，骑兵手持长枪，红色盔缨和披风被狂风拉起，马蹄踏起大量沙尘。万马奔腾尘土铺满整个战场的史诗冲锋场面。

马其顿方阵/斯巴达盾墙对抗骑兵冲锋。长矛如林盾牌互锁，骑兵冲锋被方阵化解。藤牌兵五人一组小型盾墙阵型顺势转动分散骑兵冲击力。步兵对抗骑兵的经典战术场面。

Macedonian phalanx and Spartan shield wall against a cavalry charge. A forest of spears with interlocked shields, the charge broken on the formation. Rattan-shield soldiers in five-man mini shield walls pivot to disperse the impact. The classic tactical scene of infantry against cavalry.
